description: A high-performance 3D Coin Pusher simulation featuring dynamic slot machines, physical coin mechanics, and procedural effect generation.

scenes.description: The primary gameplay scene containing the pusher assembly, coin zones, and gameplay manager.

scripts.responsibility: Handles individual coin physics, lifecycle, and interaction with scoring zones.
Manages the slot machine logic, UI billboard, and reward distribution.
Handles smooth periodic movement of the pusher object using sine waves.

humanSetupInstructions: Ensure TextMeshPro is installed in the project via Package Manager.
Assign the 'Coin' Prefab and 'Bumper' Prefab to the CoinSpawner component fields in the Inspector.
Ensure your Main Camera has a 'CameraShake' script attached (or let the auto-initializer handle it).
Attach 'GameManager' and 'UIManager' to an empty GameObject in your scene.
Place 'ScoreZone' colliders at the front of the pusher and 'SideLossZone' colliders at the left/right gaps.
